newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR largely flat in liquid market.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR largely flat in liquid market.

text.p: Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were largely steady as they reflected a slow day in the overnight markets, traders said.
The one-month rate strengthened to 9 15/16 percent from 9 7/8 percent while the six-month weakened to 10 1/4 percent from 10 5/16 percent.

A trader said the rise in the one-month and the drop in the six-month reflects a general consensus that overnight rates may rise next month on prospects of a temporary liquidity drain from tax remittances in end-January. But liquidity is expected to return to normal in the medium-term, they said.
